rooms.name: Cult Headquarters
rooms.desc: A ten-foot-high room with a black pentagram on the floor, candles at its corners.
rooms.dm: Fiona's book club: cult fanatics and cultists. They attack to keep their secret.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.desc: A root cellar with a dirt floor; four cots along the south wall; tracks in the earth lead to a bare wall.
rooms.dm: Eight skeletons under the floor; the pivot door in the west wall.

rooms.name: Secret Staircase
rooms.desc: A stone stair with iron sconces cutting down through the house.

rooms.name: Cellar Entrance (foot)
rooms.desc: The foot of the cellar steps.

objects.label: A soundproof door that pivots on a central axis in the bare west wall; the footprints give it away
Eight skeletons buried under the dirt floor, stolen from the church cemetery
A black pentagram on the stone; the 'book club' waits for Lady Wachter with candles lit.
Cult fanatics (3) and cultists (6) in black robes

rooms.name: Den
rooms.desc: A bay den of couches by the hearth, windows over dead gardens.

rooms.name: Servants' Quarters
rooms.desc: Four austere beds and chests.
rooms.dm: The servants know everything and say nothing.

rooms.name: Back Vestibule
rooms.desc: The back vestibule: a locked, banded door and three plain doors.

rooms.name: Servants' Closet
rooms.desc: A closet of brooms and aprons.
rooms.dm: Secret door in the south wall (DC 10 Perception): the stone stair to the cellar.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.desc: Barrels and crates.

rooms.name: Parlor
rooms.desc: Three elegant couches round a black-glass table; portraits on the north wall; a hearth shared with the den.

rooms.name: Staircase
rooms.desc: A wooden stair up to a balcony; three stained-glass doors at its foot.
rooms.dm: Climbs 15 ft to the upstairs hall.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: A spotless kitchen; a washbasin in the corner, a slender door to a pantry.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.desc: A small pantry.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.desc: A long table under a crystal chandelier; eight chairs with elk-horn backs; iron-and-glass windows over the fog-swept grounds.

rooms.name: Front Door and Vestibule
rooms.desc: A narrow vestibule behind a bronze-banded door; three stained-glass doors lead on; closets flank the entrance.
rooms.dm: Locked, DC 20 Strength; a servant speaks through the eye-window.

rooms.name: West Closet
rooms.desc: Lady Wachter's outdoor clothes.

rooms.name: East Closet
rooms.desc: Coats and boots of the children.

rooms.name: Den (east)
rooms.desc: A study by a hearth, tall windows over the dead gardens.

rooms.name: Cellar Entrance
rooms.desc: A slanted cellar door with an iron ring against the foundation.
rooms.dm: Unlocked; stone steps to a landing, then down to the cellar.

objects.label: A secret door in the south wall of the servants' closet: a stone stair to the cellar (DC 10 Perception)
Three stained-glass doors in wooden frames at the foot of the stair
Bronze-banded door, locked (DC 20 Strength); a servant asks your business through a small window in it.
Portraits of the Wachter line along the north wall
Three servants and the cook (commoners), loyal to the death
The house cook
Tall windows over dead gardens; the hearth is shared with the parlor

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc: A library in the bay, shelves on every wall, a desk by the window.
rooms.dm: Fiona works here with Majesto. Hinged bookcase panel to the storage room; the chest key in the desk.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.desc: A dusty ten-foot room of shelves with a curtained window; an iron chest on the bottom shelf.
rooms.dm: 180 ep, 110 gp, the Wachter pipe, five deeds from Strahd.

rooms.name: Stella's Room
rooms.desc: An iron-framed bed with leather straps.
rooms.dm: Stella, mad as a cat; locked both sides, Fiona's key only.

rooms.name: Brothers' Room (south)
rooms.desc: A neat bed, a table with a lamp, a handsome chest, a slender wardrobe.

rooms.name: Brothers' Room (north)
rooms.desc: Two beds; bottles under them.
rooms.dm: Nikolai and Karl sleep off their drink.

rooms.name: Upstairs Hall
rooms.desc: A hall wrapping the stair rail, a window at each end; something scratches at one of the doors.
rooms.dm: Stella's door. A linen closet at the south end.

rooms.name: Linen Closet
rooms.desc: Blankets and linens.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A fire struggles in the hearth under a family portrait; a canopied bed between lamp-lit tables; a man in black lies on it with coins on his eyes.
rooms.dm: Nikolai, dead three years, under gentle repose. A hooded robe in the closet.
